name: Carlberti Astea
original_name: カルベルティ・アステア
source: He meets Connie in Dylas-Leen while trying to protect a certain green-haired girl from the Imperial Army. He was apparently looking for her as well... He's combat-capable and saves the day, but his real objective is unknown.
